title: Neither Valid nor Reliable? Investigating the Use of LLMs as Judges

bias_targets.target: Cognitive bias (e.g., Position, Verbosity, Bandwagon, Compassion-fade)
bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative literature review of studies documenting LLM judges' vulnerability to structural prompt characteristics (like response order or length) and cognitive heuristics rather than objective quality.
Qualitative literature review of preference leakage and competitive benchmarking studies showing that LLM judges artificially inflate scores for outputs generated by models from their own family.
Qualitative review of literature demonstrating that LLM judges reproduce societal stereotypes and shift their evaluations in the presence of specific identity markers or demographic groups.
